thread:
marta: Starting canary deploy v2.14.0 -> 5% EU-WEST. Change window is open now. Release notes: https://releases.redwood.ai/v2.14.0 :eyes:

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Canary job 7170001111 started for v2.14.0 — target 5% traffic in eu-west. CI: https://ci.redwood.ai/builds/7170001111 :rocket:

samir: watching dashboards — will report latency & error-rate in 5m

ingrid: seeing a small 5xx uptick on inference-service (eu-west). +3% error-rate, tail latency +120ms. sample trace id: abc123

nate: can we pin region to previous stable (v2.13.9) if it looks bad? prefer regional rollback over global

marta: Hold canary at 5%. Do NOT increase traffic. @deploy-bot pause further shifts for this canary

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Canary traffic paused at configured 5%. No further shifts will occur until manual resume.

ops-bot: ops-bot: Auto-quarantine rule triggered — eu-west canary flagged for elevated error-rate. Suspending rollouts in that cohort.

samir: recommend regional rollback unless root cause is quick. If we rollback, we should update release notes and open incident page.

ingrid: quick logs show KV cache OOM on a subset of pods after quantization path changed. snippet: ```OOM at kv_cache.c:214
backtrace: infer_loop -> kv_put -> alloc_cache```

marta: Decision: pin eu-west back to v2.13.9 and rollback v2.14.0 in that region. Keep other regions paused. @ops-bot execute regional rollback and mark canary quarantined.

ops-bot: ops-bot: Executing regional rollback for eu-west -> target version v2.13.9. Steps: 1) route 5% -> previous, 2) drain new pods, 3) tag canary as quarantined. ETA ~2m.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Rollback complete for eu-west — traffic routed back to v2.13.9 (5% -> 0% new). Drained 24/24 new instances. Rollback reason: kv_cache OOM observed in canary.

nate: I'll open the incident and add an entry to release notes: "Quarantined v2.14.0 canary in EU-West due to kv_cache OOM; rolled back to v2.13.9. Investigation in progress."

marta: thanks. Do not resume other regions until we have a fix or mitigation. Change window stays open but canary is quarantined.

samir: :thumbsup: holding. Will post signal once a fix or mitigation is ready and I've run a short smoke run.
